videos.title: 讓許多人傾家蕩產的龐氏騙局(Ponzi Scheme)，這個惡名昭彰的吸金陷阱，到底是怎麼運作？

narrative.packaging_promise: Explain how a Ponzi scheme works and give novice investors a usable fraud-detection checklist.
narrative.hook_function: Lead with irreversible personal-loss risk, connect the old mechanism to a then-current crypto wrapper, and promise prevention.
narrative.central_question: How does the scheme move money, and which visible signals let a novice reject it?
narrative.viewpoint: Protective educator speaking to financial beginners, with deliberately strong language around implausible returns.
narrative.rhythm: Linear lecture with repeated questions, a long worked example, then a compact checklist payoff.
narrative.ending: Restates the audience-protection goal and asks viewers to subscribe and join the channel's messaging account.

videos.title: 上班不要看的成員出去自立門戶，這代表什麼意義？職場上的分手，到底怎麼樣看怎麼做才對？

narrative.packaging_promise: Use a current creator-company departure to explain how employees and employers should interpret and handle separation.
narrative.hook_function: Borrow attention from a current YouTube incident while explicitly acknowledging that its private details are unknown.
narrative.central_question: What does a workplace departure mean for the people involved and for the industry's opportunity cycle?
structure: View 2: outside offers test claimed market value
View 3: preserve reputation and separate well
View 4: spin-outs can signal industry opportunity
narrative.viewpoint: Balances employee mobility and employer reality, prioritizing market feedback and long-term reputation over private-event speculation.
narrative.rhythm: Short numbered-opinion essay with one practical rule per section and a broader industry interpretation at the end.
narrative.ending: Moves from the individual incident to a cautious hypothesis that creator spin-outs indicate an expanding industry.

videos.title: 除了0050以外還有什麼好的投資選擇？介紹00692公司治理ETF

narrative.packaging_promise: Give ETF beginners an alternative to 0050 and explain why 00692 may be competitive.
narrative.hook_function: Start from a familiar beginner default, introduce a lesser-known challenger, and make a bold comparative promise.
narrative.central_question: Does 00692's construction, diversification, cost and liquidity make it a credible long-term alternative to 0050?
structure: Long-term use case and conditional conclusion
narrative.viewpoint: Makes a clear personal preference while preserving a concrete drawback and tying the conclusion to a long holding period.
narrative.rhythm: Definition-first explainer, then a sequence of direct comparisons, a disadvantage section, and a concise recommendation payoff.
narrative.ending: Recaps strengths and weakness, predicts improving liquidity, then closes with a standard engagement CTA.

repeatable_mechanisms: Promise one concrete learning outcome at the opening.
Start from an audience risk, familiar default, or current event rather than from an abstract definition.
Define the unfamiliar mechanism in plain language before presenting judgment.
Organize the body as a mechanism, numbered views, or explicit comparison criteria.
Use worked examples, analogies or product comparisons to make the framework operational.
Return to the opening audience problem in the conclusion and provide a clear practical takeaway.
cross_sample_historical_pattern.abstract_pattern: Audience problem -> plain-language definition -> ordered framework -> examples/comparison -> limitation or boundary -> practical takeaway
